nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query.

A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

A type of context data determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about a context or environment of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type provides information about an environment of a mobile device and may be determined by the meaning of a term of a short message.<SEP>A classification determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about the environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides a context-data type and is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to specified parameters such as pecuniary cost.<SEP>A source that provides a given context-data type; multiple sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

A message received from a mobile device whose term meaning is used to determine a context-data type and to which metadata instructions may be appended.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, from which a context-data type may be determined and to which received context data may be appended or encoded.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context-data is linked and which is formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from or generated by a mobile device whose term meanings are analyzed to determine context-data types and to which relevant context data is linked.

A device that generates and sends the short message and whose environment the context-data type describes.<SEP>A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided; its state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>A device that sends short messages, receives rendered context data through a communication network, and generates short messages to which context data may be appended.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>At least one server that collects context data from context-data providers.
A mobile device that receives context data, to which received context data may be provided, and to which a short message and context data may be forwarded.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may comprise a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources or context data, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a source.

A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.<SEP>The monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a ranking parameter.
A storage available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database and sends context data to a receiving mobile device.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to the short message to query the database for the received context data.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking.<SEP>A network through which rendered context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives context data from the database server and whose state may be a specified parameter.

Data of a determined context-data type provided by a context-data source, having a cost value and describing a context or environment.<SEP>Data of a determined context-data type that is requested, rendered, appended, selected, collected, and linked to short messages.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method of claim 1.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations such as receiving short messages, determining context-data types, ranking sources, and generating requests.
Instructions executed by a processor to perform the described operations.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric from which context data is selected.
A measure, including monetary cost, used to weight context-data elements and to algorithmically select relevant context data.

An entity that is allowed to provide the context-data and may provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a server collects a set of context data related to the meaning of short message content.
A sensor by which the context-data is obtained.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted; it may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and a short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol that may be used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol that may be used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A device comprising at least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform the described operations.
A procedure comprising collecting context data, algorithmically selecting relevant context data, linking it to a short message, and formatting them according to a communication protocol.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted together with the short message according to a communication protocol.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The context-data acquisition and ranking method determines a context-data type from a query.
The method identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method ranks received context data or context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device with a server and determines a context-data type from a term of the short message.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device and forwards the short message and context data to the recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The method appends metadata instructions to query the database for received context data in the short message.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
